spans.text: At times we may to want find data in a database that matches a word or phrase.
One way to find the data is to manually search through the database. This process can be very time consuming, especially with large amounts of data.
The Find feature is used to search for data in a spreadsheet using keywords or phrases.
The database below shows the details of items at a bakery.
Item name | Item price | Total number of orders | Amount in store
The data is stored in a table in a spreadsheet. To search for all the cake items, follow the steps.
Click on the Find & Select icon in the Home Ribbon or press Control + F.
The Find and Replace dialog box will open.
Enter the keyword, Cake, in the Find What box.
